title: a test among hidden actions is a test of the object
purpose: Accept the construct and observe the exit status.

expect.justification: The embedded test runner's report format is not normative (spec 14 fixes only the exit status).

provenance.origin: authored for #277 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.7 and 14: a test block among the hidden actions parses as a test of the object and runs under -t; its failure makes the run exit 1.
